# AI-augmented

> The front page of a family of repositories on AI-augmented work: a person, a language model and a machine on one project. The map, the shared words, and the rule of one repository per problem with no overlap. A first-pass review names the field and the baseline.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [AI-augmented](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/evidence/README.md): the review of what the field calls this family, and its bibliography
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
